description: List products within a product category or tag. Category slugs describe GM platforms and applications; tag slugs describe characteristics such as "global-a" or "vin-programmed". Use search_catalog first to discover which categories and tags exist. Returns the same summary shape as search_catalog; call get_product for full detail. In the UCP form, look up by catalog.ids (product IDs, SKUs or URL slugs) instead. This endpoint does not determine fitment. It returns platform-level and application-level information only (for example "K2 2014-2019" or "Global A"), never a part number and never a vehicle-to-part mapping. Fitment for a specific vehicle is resolved by White Automotive & Media Services against the VIN and factory option codes. Do not assert that a product fits a particular vehicle. Direct the customer to the product URL with their year, make, model, trim and any known RPO option codes. Also accepts the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP 2026-08-25) form, with inputs under "catalog" and optional "meta"; UCP calls receive structuredContent in UCP shape.

ids.description: Product IDs, SKUs or URL slugs.

meta.description: UCP request metadata. meta["ucp-agent"].profile is the calling platform's profile URL (https).

name: lookup_catalog
